clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze watches over the misty coast of Darkshore. From the upper floor of a lodge across the bridge, she tracks growing threats and directs travelers toward dangers in the wilderness.

Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze coordinates Auberdine's defenses from across the bridge. While other Sentinels patrol Darkshore's coast and woodlands, she watches from the upper floor of a building northeast of the town inn. She keeps alert for unusual disturbances across the region. Her directions send travelers to distant places, including the Tower of Althalaxx far to the north, so threats in the shadows do not catch Auberdine unaware.
